properties.name: Disable Linked Audio feature (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting allows you to configure the Record Audio and the Record Video commands on the Insert tab.

If you enable this policy setting, the commands will be not be available.

If you disable or do not configure this policy, the commands will be available.

properties.name: Rewind from start of paragraph by the following number of seconds (User)
properties.description: Sets the value in the corresponding UI option.

properties.name: Rewind from start of paragraph by: (sec) (User)
Specify number of bits to sample when recording (User)
properties.description: Specifies the default number of bits per sample (value is in kbps) used when recording audio. If the appropriate codec is found, then this is the default bit depth used in the Format setting for Linked Audio, found under File tab | Options | Audio & Video.

properties.name: Specify number of channels to record (User)
properties.description: Specifies whether 1 or 2 channels are used when recording audio. If the appropriate codec is found, then this is the default number of channels used in the Format setting for Linked Audio found under File tab | Options | Audio & Video.

properties.name: Specify rate to sample audio (bits/second) (User)
properties.description: Specifies the default sample rate (value is in kHz) used when recording audio. If the appropriate codec is found, then this is the default sample rate used in the Format setting for Linked Audio found under File tab | Options | Audio & Video.
